properties.description: Ends this terminal path after all four standard outputs are populated.

Resolves one exact validated workload definition version, identifies the current preferred version, and internally summarizes deployments that follow the preferred version. An already-preferred target with no strategy change is an idempotent success. Every state-changing request otherwise fails closed with 422 before PATCH because service-side clearing of a previous PreferredVersion flag, rollback behavior, and active-deployment rollout effects remain explicit live-tenant gates. No deployment collection is returned. Canary writeability follows CiscoDevNet SDK commit 0e8dfdb798aac11684966f0edbbd5e5ea3106dff.
